Claim and release

You will learn

How a claim is taken and given back, and why the discipline matters.

A claim is a promise: one client holds the lock, works, and gives it back. The recording takes the claim with tri fpga-claim and the chip that follows it gives it back with tri fpga-release -- take and return recorded back to back, the bench reporting who holds it and then itself free. The spec is the tool card of tri fpga-claim.

Try it

In the recording, watch the claim land and the release land; then in the spec frame find what tri fpga-claim refuses when the lock is held.

Open the interactive lesson →
